args.title: Incident summary: double charge on retry
args.body:
The thread reports a payments double-charge bug whose root cause, per maya, is retry.py failing to carry the idempotency key across a second attempt, affecting roughly 40 orders per day. Jordan confirmed the behavior in staging and said the fix is to persist the idempotency key before the first capture, which is already implemented in PR #481. Maya then asked for an issue to be filed in the payments-api repo so the incident is tracked.

_Source: Slack thread 18291 in #payments._
